text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, solving problems, and making decisions. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed instructions, computers learn from data and improve over time. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses large artificial neural networks to recognise patterns. AI is already part of daily life. For example, it helps recommend films on streaming services, powers voice assistants on our phones, filters spam emails, and supports doctors in diagnosing illnesses. AI is not science fiction; it is a technology we use every day.
